prompt: If Mr. Rogers were still alive, how old would he have been when the movie "A Beautiful Day in the Neighborhood", featuring Tom Hanks came out in the U.S.?
answer: Fred Rogers was born on March 20, 1928. When *A Beautiful Day in the Neighborhood* was released in the U.S. on November 22, 2019, he would have been **91 years old**.
